notes.title: June Dev Update – The Rewinder 2
notes.notes: [p]The beginning of June was tough. A familiar environment changed unexpectedly, so I took a short break to reset—spent some time with family, went on a trip, watched a few films, and revisited some screenwriting books to clear my mind.[/p][p]Mid-month marked the official start of the Rewinder 2 remake.[/p][p]Most of this month was spent reworking the narrative and refining character development. On one hand, the story needs to integrate the newly added rewind dream levels. On the other, we're addressing some long-standing narrative structure issues:[/p][p]The Rewinder 2 has a large cast of NPCs, but many lacked depth, making it hard for players to feel invested in them or their stories.[/p][p]Key world-building elements were introduced too late in the plot, leading to a disjointed experience that felt like a deus ex machina.[/p][p]Some of these problems now have clear solutions; others still need time and iteration.[/p][p]The rest of June was spent drafting a new opening sequence and laying the groundwork for several ewind dream levels levels.[/p][p]This remake has turned out to be far more demanding than I initially expected. A book on screenwriting once said: After the darkest night of the soul comes the final battle. For me, finishing this remake is that battle. Whether the ending is happy or bittersweet, this story isn't over yet.[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who's shown us care and support. If you have thoughts on the story or the rewind dream levels, feel free to leave me a message—I'd love to hear your ideas.[/p]

notes.title: An Update on Major Changes Coming to The Rewinder 2
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, I’m Xinyu, the producer of [i]The Rewinder[/i].[/p][p]After carefully reviewing the project, I’ve decided to implement major adjustments to [i]The Rewinder 2[/i] in the following areas:[/p][list][*][p][b]Redesigning the "Rewind" levels[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Revamping village stories[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjusting the narrative[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reworking map designs[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improving combat mechanics[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhancing puzzle-solving and deduction elements[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]English Translation[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]I hope to bring these changes to refine the overall gameplay experience.[/p][p]Given that the studio has disbanded and our funds are exhausted, this overhaul will require more time. However, I promise to complete all updates within [b]six months[/b]. To keep players informed, we’ll release [b]regular progress reports[/b] detailing the current status and completed tasks. I encourage everyone to follow [b]our discord or social media[/b]—not only to stay updated but also to hold us accountable.[/p][p]Since we want to focus our efforts on polishing the game to its ideal state, [i]The Rewinder 2[/i] won’t receive major updates in the short term. However, we’ll continue fixing [b]bugs and technical issues[/b]. I hope that after this large-scale update, [i]The Rewinder 2[/i] will finally meet everyone’s expectations.[/p][p]Lastly, I want to address the overwhelming response to my previous letter. I received many messages of [b]support, encouragement, and constructive criticism[/b]. Many players even offered suggestions or expressed a desire to help the studio in various ways—thank you all so much for your kindness.[/p][p]That said, simply purchasing the game is already the greatest support you can give. If you’re unsatisfied with [i]The Rewinder 2[/i] in its current state, you might consider supporting the series by purchasing:[/p][list][*][p][b][i]The Rewinder 1[/i][/b] and its [b]DLC[/b][/p][/*][*][p][i]The Rewinder 2[/i]’s [b]original soundtrack (OST)[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Your understanding means the world to me, and I hope to repay your trust with [b]action, not just words[/b].[/p]

notes.title: A Letter from the Producer of The Rewinder
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone, I’m Xinyu, the producer of [i]The Rewinder[/i]. Thank you all so much for purchasing and playing our game. I sincerely apologize for the numerous issues at launch—we failed to deliver an experience that meets your expectations.[/p][p]A major reason for this stems from our initial vision: we aimed for too much, dreamed too big, but lacked the experience to properly execute it.[/p][p]After the first game received widespread praise, I hoped our studio could grow rapidly and push our limits. But the reality is, attempting change and tackling new challenges proved far harder than expected. Due to the team’s inexperience, we cycled through trial and error during development, repeatedly scrapping and reworking ideas, which led to massive resource waste. Players who tried the earlier demo might’ve noticed that the final version already underwent significant changes. Those who joined the beta test a month before launch also saw how drastically the game evolved in those final weeks. The team worked overtime to the point of exhaustion, barely meeting the release deadline—resulting in countless bugs, unresolved issues, and underdeveloped systems. [i]The Rewinder 2[/i]’s sheer scale drained all our resources. We poured everything into this project, leaving us no choice but to launch as-is.[/p][p]Of course, none of these problems should’ve been shouldered by you, the players who love games. We’ve seen all your feedback, critiques, frustrations, and even anger—we take full responsibility. This was my fault for being overly ambitious, chasing innovation while losing sight of why players loved [i]The Rewinder[/i] in the first place.[/p][p]As mentioned, [i]The Rewinder 2[/i] exhausted our remaining funds. Imperfect as it is, the studio now faces immense pressure. With meager revenue, our studio risks disbanding. It breaks my heart to part with the team who fought alongside me till the end, all due to my misjudgments. But I won’t abandon [i]The Rewinder 2[/i]. This isn’t just for the players—it’s for myself also. I’ll do everything possible to polish and improving the game.[/p][p]Soon, I’ll share a detailed update roadmap to remake The Rewinder 2. I hope to invite you back to the world of The Rewinder someday, to continue Qiyun and Mingxin’s extraordinary journey.[/p]

notes.title: The Rewinder 2 Now Available
notes.notes:
Dear players,

The Rewinder 2 is finally here! The game is now available on Steam for $15.99 USD, with a 10% launch discount for the first two weeks. If you purchase it as part of the series bundle, you'll receive an additional 10% off on top of the launch discount!
We’ve also teamed up with the critically acclaimed Eastward for a special bundle—buying both titles together will unlock another extra 10% discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53480
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53215
[u][b]Please note: An English version is available at launch, but some minor translation issues may still exist (they won't affect gameplay). We'll be working on improving the localization within the next two weeks.[/b][/u]

As the director of The Rewinder 2, I feel both nervous and excited today.
Looking back on this three-year journey since we started in March 2022, most of the development has been filled with joy—but also its fair share of challenges.

The Rewinder 2 represents a bold new attempt. We made major changes to deliver something fresher and richer. Exploring new mechanics and ideas brought us energy and excitement, but since this was our first time building an RPG-like experience, we also faced many difficulties. We rewrote and redesigned large parts of the game multiple times, the schedule stretched longer, and at one point, we even ran into serious funding issues.
But we pushed through—and now, the game has finally reached you.

We couldn’t have made it this far without your continued support and encouragement. The love players showed for the original Rewinder gave us the strength to keep going. We wanted to give back to those who believed in this world—to expand it, enrich it, and fill it with more possibilities and surprises.

I also want to express my deepest thanks to every member of the MistyMountainStudio team. You turned this idea on paper into something real. Even when funding ran low and salaries were delayed, even when we moved into a smaller, more modest office—no one complained. Everyone kept giving it their all, and during every design discussion, I could still see the light in your eyes. It’s been an honor to work with you.
And to our composer kala—thank you for your beautiful soundtrack and theme song. Your music has brought so much life and emotion to the world of The Rewinder 2.

Finally, I hope The Rewinder 2 brings you a meaningful and memorable experience. Every time you say “this was fun,” it reminds us why we made this game in the first place.
There may still be issues to improve, so please send us your feedback. We’ll keep working hard to make the game even better.
The story of The Rewinder 2 and its players is only just beginning.

— Xinyu
Director, The Rewinder 2

notes.title: The Rewinder 2 – Pre-Launch Q&A
notes.notes:
[b]When will The Rewinder 2 be released?[/b]
The Rewinder 2 will launch on May 26, 2025 at 3:00 PM (Beijing Time GMT+8).

[b]What is the game’s price?[/b]
The game is priced $15.99 USD, with a 10% launch discount during the first two weeks.
Additionally, players who own the original The Rewinder will receive an extra 10% discount on top of the launch offer.

[b]How long is the game?[/b]
You can expect over 10 hours of gameplay.

[b]What kind of content does the game include?[/b]
The game features a large interconnected world map, with distinct regions like deserts, snowy peaks, coastal fishing villages, and classical Chinese gardens—each with their own atmosphere and folklore.
Compared to the first game, The Rewinder 2 greatly expands the series’ mythological universe, featuring:
- Over 100 unique characters
- More than 40 types of monsters

[b]What platform will the game release on?[/b]
The game will be available on Steam.

[b]Are there multiple endings?[/b]
Yes, the game features multiple endings.

[b]Will the game support macOS?[/b]
Yes, The Rewinder 2 will be Mac-compatible.

[b]What control options are available?[/b]
The game supports both keyboard & mouse and controller play.

[b]Is the game multilingual?[/b]
Yes, The Rewinder 2 will support multiple languages, including English and Simplified Chinese.

[b]Do I need to play the first game to enjoy The Rewinder 2?[/b]
Not at all!
While The Rewinder 2 continues the story after the original game, it tells a standalone narrative. You can jump right in and enjoy a complete story without prior knowledge. That said, if you’ve played the first game, you’ll notice some familiar characters making a return—which adds to the experience, but isn’t required.

[b]What are the major changes compared to the original Rewinder?[/b]
- The camera perspective has shifted from side-scrolling to top-down.
- New types of environmental puzzles that tie more closely to the world’s mythology and story.
- A new name-guessing system is introduced before the original rewinding mechanism.
- Introduction of a map system, more exploration, combat, and a new amulet system for customizing abilities.

[b]Why did the gameplay change so much compared to the first title?[/b]
We’ve always wanted to expand the world of The Rewinder, and this time we aimed to create a richer, more varied gameplay experience while keeping the story at the heart of the series.
We know the narrative is the most important part of the Rewinder series, and we’ve worked hard to refine the story while exploring new gameplay possibilities.

[b]I’m not good at action games—can I still enjoy The Rewinder 2?[/b]
Absolutely!
We’ve designed the game with both new players and fans of the original in mind.
We know many players of the first game weren’t action gamers, so we’ve included features to make The Rewinder 2 more accessible. You’ll be able to improve your combat abilities through items and skills, and we’ve added two difficulty modes that can be switched at any time:
- Recommended Mode: The default experience with full mechanics.
- Story Mode: A more relaxed experience where your character can’t die and combat stats are adjusted to let you focus on the narrative.
Choose the mode that fits your playstyle and enjoy the journey however you prefer!


We’re doing our best to expand the gameplay and introduce new possibilities—without compromising the narrative heart of the series. We also know that every new direction comes with risk. We’re deeply grateful for the continued support of players, fans, creators, and media around the world. Thank you for walking this path with us.

notes.title: Rewinder 2 Coming to Steam Soon!
notes.notes:
Dear Rewinders,
We are so excited to anounce [b]The Rewinder 2[/b] - the project we have been working on for the last two years. It is our studio's second game and first sequel.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2915490/2/

[h1]About the Game[/h1]

The Rewinder 2 is an action adventure game based on eastern methology. This is a direct sequel taking place 2 years after the events of the original game. No prior knowledge of the original Rewinder is needed, though there are plenty of connections.

There is a lot of new stuff we would like to bring to this sequel. You may notice the game has become top-down view. We would like to focus on bringing more exploration and spatial puzzle solving experience this time. While keeping the rewinding concept, the game will introduce several new systems. You will gain new skills and charms while exploring dungeons and meet all sorts of ghosts and monsters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000767/db29884cb11fa1df6bf307683eb45e799994c555.png[/img]

We will reveal more content in upcoming months. I can't wait to see how you feel about it. Your feedback is always key to our development.

[h1]About Misty Mountain Studio[/h1]

We, as an indepandent game studio, aim to bring unique experience to our players. Our studio is founded in Melbourne, Australia in 2018. Our first game, The Rewinder, has received over 6000 reviews and rated overwelmingly positive on Steam. The Rewinder 1 has also joined XGP recently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000767/61c9bc8d8e4fb6891f25ff0711c777a550ddef69.png[/img]

[h1]Wishlist Now[/h1]
Our journey can not be completed without you. Please [u][b]wishlist[/b][/u] now.
